test_description: Verify 'Last-Write-Wins' conflict resolution during offline-to-online transition
business_risk: Critical - Data loss or corruption destroys user trust
preconditions: User logged in; Device A offline; Device B online; Initial data synced
test_steps: 1. Device A (Offline): Update Book X progress to page 50; 2. Device B (Online): Update Book X progress to page 60; 3. Device B syncs; 4. Device A goes Online and syncs
expected_result: Server and both devices reflect the state of the latest timestamp (UTC); 'Dirty' flags cleared locally
test_data_needs: User account; Pre-populated library in Isar DB
dependencies: Background Sync Service; Isar Database; Backend Sync API
success_criteria: Data consistency across endpoints; No data loss; Sync completes < 5s
data_setup_complexity: High - Requires manipulating local DB state

test_description: Verify App Store Webhook processing for subscription expiration
business_risk: High - Revenue loss or user unauthorized access
preconditions: Premium user exists; Valid subscription record in Aurora DB
test_steps: 1. Generate mock Apple Server Notification (DID_FAIL_TO_RENEW); 2. POST to /api/webhooks/apple; 3. Query User DB for role status
expected_result: User role downgrades to 'Free'; Audit log created; Client receives status update on next token refresh
test_data_needs: Mock Webhook Payload (JWT signed); Test User ID
failure_impact: High - Free access to premium features

test_description: Verify Rate Limiting and Circuit Breaker on Google Books Proxy
business_risk: Medium - API Quota exhaustion / Denial of Service
preconditions: Redis Cache running; Backend Service running
test_steps: 1. Simulate burst of 100 search requests/sec; 2. Verify 429 Too Many Requests returned after threshold; 3. Simulate External API failure; 4. Verify Circuit Breaker opens
expected_result: Rate limits enforced per IP/User; Circuit Breaker prevents cascading failure; Fallback error returned
success_criteria: System stability under load; No API keys leaked
